name: dracula
description: Dracula theme for Claude Code: padded prompt/reply boxes, coloured markdown, a session status line and an optional spoken narrator.

narratorVoice.title: Narrator voice
narratorVoice.description: A voice name (Mónica, Microsoft Helena) to always speak with. Empty: the best voice installed for the language Claude speaks, or the English one.

narratorModel.title: Model that writes the narration
narratorModel.description: An alias (haiku) or a full model id.
